text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Hey, don't go changing the choreography on the fly!
It's tough keeping up with you!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
It all worked out, so what's the problem?!
It got everyone hyped up, too!

The two of them performed at the city-sponsored Christmas live.
They were also invited to the special party
being held afterward.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"Whoaaa, awesooome!!
Look, they're doing magic tricks!"

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
That orchestra playing over there!
I just saw them on TV the other day!
Live music really is on another level, isn't it...!

There were also various card game tables and more.
Faced with the gorgeous furnishings and entertainment,
the two seemed to completely forget they were even fighting!
choice_data_list: Go out there and have a great time!

text_block_list.name: Magician
text_block_list.text:
Now, when I lift this cloth—presto!
The ball that was supposed to be in your hand is right here!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Why?! I definitely had it...!
Vodka, did you see anything?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
A-Aweeesome! That's straight-up magic, right there!
Show me again! Do it again!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Seriously, you...
You're getting way too excited. Just like a kid... Heheh.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
“—Hey, you can see the ground from here!
Santa is giving presents to children...!”

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
When I was a kid, I ran up like that too.
I ended up pulling Santa's beard and got scolded for it.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, that's so like you.
You didn't learn your lesson and kept trying over and over, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Haaah!? How'd you know that!?
I never told you about it, did I...?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: I can see right through you♪

After regrouping with Daiwa Scarlet and the others,
the three of us moved to the dinner hall.
It was a visibly formal buffet.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
It has a more authentic atmosphere than I expected.
Seems quite different from a regular buffet.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Whoaaa! Every single one of these looks delicious! Down the hatch!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Ah, hey, Vodka! Wait up, will you?!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Excuse me, comin' through! Heheh, look at this mountain of food I scored!

text_block_list.name: Party Attendee A
text_block_list.text:
"My, you really have a healthy appetite~.
Being so full of energy is a wonderful thing, fufufu."

text_block_list.name: Party Attendee B
text_block_list.text: High spirits are the best thing for kids! Ahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Haaah... Right?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Um, everyone, please excuse me!
I am so sorry for disturbing your meal!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Vodka, come over here for a second...!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
“—Ack, bad manners?!
But nobody ever says anything about it normally, y'know?”

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Today isn't like a school party, you know.
Everyone needs to wait in line, follow the flow, and take small portions onto their plates.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: No wonder everyone was laughing...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
My bad. I really don't get
stuff like this... Made a fool out of you, didn't I?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
...I kind of feel out of place, anyway.
You two just go have fun together!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Are you seriously saying that!?
You really are an idiot!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Wh-what...! Calling me stupid is going too far!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: I'm not embarrassed at all, and I don't think Vodka is unfit either!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: I was mad that they treated you like a kid!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: If you're my rival, then prove them wrong!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Just like during a race... blow them all away!
You can do it, right?!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Ah...... If you're gonna say that much,
then I've got no choice but to do this!!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Then we'll just have to show them
how amazing we really are!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Sounds fun! Count me in!
...So, what're we gonna do?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Let's see... How about something like this?
You see—

text_block_list.name: Party Attendee B
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, that girl is from earlier...
What's about to begin...?"

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Merry Christmas!
Is everyone having fun!?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"To make things even more fun,
we're gonna deliver a special song!"

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text:
Please listen!
"Our Bluebird Days"!

A special stage performance suddenly began.
With their perfectly synchronized performance,
the two of them whipped the crowd into a frenzy!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Then we'll just have to show them
how amazing we really are!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Sounds fun! Count me in!
...So, what're we gonna do?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Let's see... How about something like this?
You see—

text_block_list.name: Party Attendee B
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, that girl is from earlier...
What's about to begin...?"

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Merry Christmas!
Is everyone having fun!?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"To make things even more fun,
we're gonna deliver a special song!"

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text:
Please listen!
"Our Bluebird Days"!

The two gave it everything they had
to hype up the venue. By the time they left the stage,
they were completely exhausted.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"Well then, time for revenge.
Copy what I do.
...Here we go."

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Just one sharing plate. Arrange the dishes
in good balance, one by one... keeping it visually pleasing too.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Whoa...! You're amazing. You're actually starting to look like a real high-class lady...!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
S-Save the flattery!
Come on, you need to practice too.

As the two served themselves using proper etiquette, admiring murmurs arose from the surroundings.
Daiwa Scarlet's manners lesson was a huge success!

The party ended—and the two returned,
their faces brimming with satisfaction and confidence.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Hey, wanna come to another party like this sometime?
After all, we went through the trouble of learning the manners!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Geez, you gain confidence way too fast.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
...Well, if it's with you today,
I suppose I could consider it a little.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"Well then, time for revenge.
Copy what I do.
...Here we go."

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Just one sharing plate. Arrange the dishes
in good balance, one by one... keeping it visually pleasing too.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Whoa...! You're amazing. You're actually starting to look like a real high-class lady...!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
S-Save the flattery!
Come on, you need to practice too.

As the two served themselves using proper etiquette, admiring murmurs arose from the surroundings.
Looks like we'll manage to pull through...!

And by the time they returned from the party,
the two of them were completely exhausted.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
If I'm going out with you,
it really needs to be somewhere more casual...
